scope: Uniform prefix saturation and direction bounds for matroids on full additive-valuation sublevels whose bases permit lowering valuation, with the entire explicit nested polynomial family and generic fixed-order Taylor jets as applications. All valuations and true quotient lengths are covered by the proof; finite controls do not certify novelty or the unrestricted G_3 endpoint.

two_cone_boundary_control.claim_limit: This binomial control violates the lowering hypothesis. Its quadratic primitive direction product does not imply a large initial fan.

generic_fixed_order_jet_controls.scope: One explicit normalized nonexponential Taylor point has every predicted subset rank; a special monomial point has extra dependencies. The general nonempty-open assertion uses the finite nonzero-minor product proof, not these two points.
